name: Browser screenshot
description: Captures the current visual state of the visible in-app browser and stores it as an artifact, returning a summary plus reference.

localizedDescription.zh-CN: 对用户眼前可见的内嵌浏览器当前画面截图，结果以 artifact 落盘，仅返回摘要与引用，不直接回灌大图。
localizedDescription.en-US: Captures the current visual state of the visible in-app browser and stores it as an artifact, returning a summary plus reference.
